verdict.rationale: Unstructured's workflow/job APIs and connectors are explicitly designed to process many files/documents at once — jobs process source-to-destination pipelines across 65+ file types and 35+ connectors, with job tracking, status monitoring, and batch download of results. Missing for 10: no explicit documented batch-size limits or throughput benchmarks, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming bulk performance at scale beyond vendor docs.
